title: Gloria (Gaspar, Missa Se mieulx ne vient)
desc: Gaspar van Weerbeke, Missa Se mieulx ne vient, Gloria. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. From the Josquin Research Project (josquin.stanford.edu, Gas0104b), edited by Agnese Pavanello (Gaspar van Weerbeke: Collected Works. I. Masses, Part 1, 2016); encoded by Roland Mair-Gruber. Edition published by American Institute of Musicology. Copyright 2014, Pavanello, Agnese. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0; converted to Cantare notation (tools/kern2cantare.py). Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve); coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
